reviews.reason: The selected text follows printed p72/PDF110 into p74/PDF112, preserving ወ*ከመ, [ሠናይ፡ ወ], and final ርእየቱ። before numbered 6. The English transparently retains both occurrences of “beautiful” and “delightful,” without importing a tree identity or Greek wording. Acceptance is limited to this individual unit; 32:2–4 and 32:6 remain held.
reviews.suggested_text: And I said, “This tree is beautiful, and how [beautiful and] delightful its appearance is!”[a]
reviews.footnote_changes: None. Retain note a: it correctly identifies printed p74 apparatus note 2, “Omit with G, q,” as recommending omission of the bracketed words, without claiming independent manuscript verification.
reviews.suggested_source_text: ወእቤ፡ ሠናይዝ፡ ዕፀ፡ ወ*ከመ፡ [ሠናይ፡ ወ]ፍሡሕ፡ ርእየቱ።
